# Synthetic fixture (INF06-01): SAM Globals give an API handler, a queue consumer and a nightly job one size.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    MemorySize: 1024
    Timeout: 30
    Architectures: [arm64]
Resources:
  ApiFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: api.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Events:
        Get:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            Path: /items
            Method: get
  QueueConsumer:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: consumer.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Events:
        Jobs:
          Type: SQS
          Properties:
            Queue: !GetAtt JobsQueue.Arn
  NightlyReport:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: report.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Events:
        Nightly:
          Type: Schedule
          Properties:
            Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
  SeedData:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: seed.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      MemorySize: 256
  JobsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue

# Synthetic fixture (INF06-01): Serverless provider defaults size every function the same way.
service: orders
provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  memorySize: 2048
  timeout: 900
functions:
  createOrder:
    handler: src/create.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /orders
          method: post
  fulfil:
    handler: src/fulfil.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: arn:aws:sqs:ap-south-1:111111111111:orders
  purge:
    handler: src/purge.handler
    events:
      - eventBridge:
          schedule: rate(1 day)
